Usage: actual accounts [options] [command]

Manage accounts

Options:
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  list [options]          List all accounts
  create [options]        Create a new account
  update [options] <id>   Update an account
  close [options] <id>    Close an account
  reopen <id>             Reopen a closed account
  delete <id>             Delete an account
  balance [options] <id>  Get account balance
  help [command]          display help for command
